meta.policy: Read-only audit of inherited repository content. Files owned by other sessions are flagged, never edited. 'Repo' links point at the exact file on GitHub; rule links point at the official source fetched this session.

findings.finding: Root redirect to docs/ dashboard is intact and relative; works under the /China2/ Pages subpath. Three parallel dashboards (docs/, site/, portal/) exist; cross-link requests to a unified entry are logged in COORDINATION.md by their owners, not actioned here.

Method counts differ across parallel deliverables: README/docs say 22 routes; data/methods.json contains 18; reports ledger 22; this session counted 67 findings and 24 sources in research/ (matches docs claims). Not an error within any one dashboard, but a cross-dashboard inconsistency for readers. Published as F12.

States the USD 50,000 quota covers 'purchases and sales, for domestic and foreign individuals' citing the 2007 SAFE press conference. The 2024 SAFE Tianjin FAQ says only Foreign Permanent Resident ID holders enjoy the purchase facilitation quota; Art. 2 of the Detailed Rules says settlement (all individuals) and domestic-individual purchases. The blanket purchase-side wording is overbroad for foreign passport holders. Published as F04.

'A US citizen can walk into a bank and convert at most USD 500 equivalent per day' overgeneralizes Art. 13(2)/Guidelines Art. 60: the ID-only small-amount rule is for RECONVERSION of previously exchanged unused RMB, not conversion of any RMB balance. Confirmed against SAFE 2026-09-17 FAQ. Concurrent audits (audit-252753e7, audit-86f0 branches) flagged the same. Published as F06; owner notified via board.

Categorical '0% if already taxed' and 'additional PRC tax to convert and wire is ZERO' lack the caveats that (a) tax attaches to income categories under the IIT Law, (b) the FTC is limited by the US-source ratio, and (c) undocumented amounts cannot use the route at all. Directionally consistent with the rules fetched (no conversion-tax provision exists in S01/S06/S13/S15) but stated too absolutely. Published as F06.

Portal M03 'Walk-In Small-Amount RMB->USD Re-conversion (Passport Only)' presents the narrow unused-RMB reconversion as a general method. Same root cause as A04. The portal's own verifier checks structure (109 rows, .gov links, blank cells), not source meaning - it passes despite this substantive issue.

9 of 17 sources are labeled 'text returned by search index' rather than full retrieval (S03, S07, S08, S12-S17). That session disclosed the weaker evidence tier itself. This session re-fetched full text for the overlapping rules (quota, ATM caps, FBAR, FTC, FEIE, treaty, 988) - see sources.json S01-S31, all 'fetched'.

Claimed counts (22 routes, 24 sources, 9 flags) match research/findings.json (67 findings), research/sources.json (24) and the review page flags as counted this session. Internal consistency verified.
